title: UK SME Balance Sheets and Filing Behaviour
description:
Balance sheet benchmarks and filing behaviour for UK small and medium-sized companies, computed from 366,209 sets of accounts filed at Companies House.

Current ratio, net current assets and filing timeliness, broken down by employee size band.

Note on scope: figures are given per employee size band. The deposit contains no all-company median and no sector breakdown — any pooled figure must be presented as a range across bands, not as a single median.

Published by Finance Clearly, a publication of Edwards Bros (Spaldwick) Ltd.
